## Gap ID
GAP-002 / SEC-001/SEC-002 (related)

## Source
gap-analysis-feature-parity, gap-analysis-security

## Description
OSimFlow has no user authentication or multi-user collaboration features. It is designed as a single-user CLI tool. openstudio-server provides:
- User accounts and authentication
- Project sharing and collaboration
- Access control (RBAC)

## Evidence
- No auth module in `osimflow/`
- AGENTS.md §0.1 confirms no auth layer
- No user management endpoints

## Severity
Major

## Recommended Mitigation
This is by design for MVP. Document the single-user scope clearly. For multi-user scenarios, recommend deploying OSimFlow per-user or behind an auth proxy.

## Labels
gap-analysis, feature-parity, security, major
